Job-Description:
## Job title
Environmental Counselor

## Job Summary
This position is meant for an experienced Environmental Counselor who would lead our team in managing the environmental impact of our operations, using their knowledge in Plant Biology, Environmental Science, Soil Chemistry, Soil Physics, and employing their Critical Thinking and Problem Solving skills for drafting solutions and communicating them effectively through Technical Writing.

## Required Skills
- A good understanding of Plant Biology and Environmental Science
- Proficiency in Technical Writing for good communication
- Strong Critical Thinking and Problem Solving abilities 
- Grasp on Soil Chemistry and Soil Physics

## Required Experience
- At least 2 years experience working as an Environmental Counselor 
- At least 2 years experience working as a Soil and Plant Scientist

## Responsibilities
- Drafting environmental impact reports based on biological, environmental and soil data
- Offering scientifically-backed advice to stakeholders on environmental best practices
- Assessing, predicting, and addressing potential environmental risks
- Conducting and reviewing ecological studies, and drafting related documentation
